decision: Propose retaining karol-modzelewski and raising the identity confidence to 0.85 as a source-local entity inference; keep the original spelling, preferences, status and all extraction/source lineage. No alias is asserted.
evidence: The saved complete author post literally says “Karola Modrzelewskiego” alongside “Olke Szczęśniak” while praising their level; the original Reddit source is a Polish stand-up discussion.

In Polish inflection, Karola Modzelewskiego corresponds to Karol Modzelewski; the observed surname adds r after d, with the rest matching. This is an inferred spelling error, not an exact canonical surname or an independently verified alias.

The frozen population contains Karol Modzelewski and Karol Kopiec; Kopiec’s surname does not match. Inspection of the 100 frozen names found no competing close full-name match. This cannot rule out a performer outside the population.

The saved official standup.pl profile identifies Karol Modzelewski as a performer and associates him with Newsy bez wirusa. The collector also reports kv665 naming him and the series; the locator inconsistency prevents relying on that comment as same-thread evidence or as proof of the original author’s intent.
alternatives_considered: Retaining 0.74 is defensible given the spelling and no direct binding, but the full inflected first and nearly identical surname, stand-up context, named peer and source-backed canonical performer together support a stronger local inference. A direct author acknowledgment is not required.

A different Karol Kopiec or an outside-population person is possible in principle, but neither has a positive identity cue in the saved passage; Kopiec is a poor surname match. Nulling the identity would discard a well-supported inference.
confidence_rationale: 0.85 expresses substantial but imperfect confidence in this particular referent, based on the combined name and topical evidence; it is a model judgment, not a measured probability or a value selected to achieve coverage. It is lower than an exact, directly disambiguated name because the extra r and lack of source-local explicit binding leave room for another referent. The 0.75 graph rule is unchanged.
remaining_risks: The author did not explicitly identify a profile or programme; a different similarly named person outside the frozen population remains possible. A source-local statement connecting this spelling to a work, profile, or canonical name would materially reduce that risk.
The ledger does not establish that kv665 is in the original thread. No additional source was retrieved or claim of alias verification made.
